cli.description: AUTOCATCHSUBS JR — transcripción local para DaVinci Resolve

args.name: input
args.description: Path to the audio or video file to transcribe.

args.name: model
args.description: Transcription model: a Whisper size (tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3, large-v3-turbo, plus .en variants), parakeet, or a moonshine variant (moonshine-tiny, moonshine-base, ...). Downloaded automatically if missing. Default: small. See --list-models.

args.name: list-models
args.description: List the available transcription models and exit.

args.name: output
args.description: Write to this file instead of stdout (format inferred from extension if --format is omitted).

args.name: format
args.description: Output format: text (default), json, srt, or vtt.

args.name: lang
args.description: Source language code (e.g. en). Auto-detected if omitted.

args.name: max-speakers
args.description: Maximum number of speakers when diarizing.

args.name: forced-alignment
args.description: Refine word timestamps with the optional MMS forced aligner.

args.name: density
args.description: Subtitle text density: less, standard, more, single, or custom.

args.name: max-chars-per-line
args.description: Custom maximum characters per line (used with --density custom).

args.name: text-case
args.description: Text case: none, lowercase, uppercase, or titlecase.
